hints.title: Sequential Insertion
hints.text: Follow the instructions step by step: at step i, insert nums[i] into the target array at index index[i].

hints.title: Shift Existing Elements
hints.text: Inserting at index idx automatically shifts elements currently at or to the right of idx one position rightward.

hints.title: Direct List Insertion
hints.text: Since n is at most 100, standard list insert operations provide a straightforward linear simulation.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of nums and index arrays
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Array insertions shift up to N elements per step, causing O(N^2) worst case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since N <= 100, O(N^2) insertion is well within execution limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate simulates list insertion directly or mentions segment trees for large N.
complexity.notes: Index array values are valid 0 <= index[i] <= i.
